functions.name: Y7 Feedback API Preview
functions.commands: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@10.32.1 --activate && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --filter @y7-feedback/config build && pnpm --filter @y7-feedback/domain build && pnpm --filter @y7-feedback/api build
functions.ignore:
.git
.github
.env*
node_modules
dist
docs
apps
coverage
playwright-report
test-results
*.tsbuildinfo
